summary: This program stores three shopping cart items in variables and joins them into one readable line using string concatenation. The + operator glues strings together, and the ", " pieces supply the separators between item names.

lines.text: The first item name is stored in a variable so it can be reused later instead of being typed again inside the print call.
Concatenating a label onto the finished list produces a full sentence; note that + only works here because both sides are strings.
